name: ScanBox higher-quality vision pack (Qwen2.5-VL-3B)
notes: OPTIONAL. ScanBox already ships Florence-2 (base ~355MB or large ~1.06GB) that 'Install or update local AI model' in Settings > AI downloads with no setup, letting you pick a size.

Copy this file to config\vision_pack.json ONLY if you want this different, llama.cpp-based Qwen2.5-VL-3B model instead of either Florence-2 size. This file overrides the built-in pack entirely, and disables the base/large size choice.
Qwen2.5-VL-3B reads dense documents and photos noticeably better, but the pack is about 2.8 GB.
The installer downloads these files into engines\vision, extracts the runtime, then auto-detects the runtime and model and writes config\vision_command.txt for you.
Leave out the command field to let ScanBox auto-configure it. Provide one only to override the auto-detected command.
Keep every URL pointed at a trusted host. Do not point command at a cloud API if you want ScanBox to stay fully local.
